subject: [PATCH v6 08/12] mm: handle PMD swap entries in MADV_WILLNEED

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch enhances the handling of PMD swap entries in MADV_WILLNEED operations. It ensures that when a PMD-sized swap entry is encountered, it is properly prefetched and split into individual slots if necessary. The patch also addresses potential issues such as losing a race with per-slot swap-cache population or hitting an -ENOMEM error during PMD-order allocation. The approach taken involves checking the cache state of the PMD swap entry, pinning the swap device, and reading the folio in at PMD order via swapin_sync. If any failure occurs, the entry is split and the PTE path is retried to handle each slot individually.
